# What Works

> What Works: a living atlas of what works in public policy, every programme graded by its trials and re-graded as evidence lands.

Every hour the beat checks the programmes checked longest ago, resolves their citations, searches two indexes for new trials and reviews, reads them in under the verbatim-quote guard, recomputes every grade and logs each move with its reason, with no person in the middle

## Live

- [What Works](https://what-works.ultrastable.org/): the running system
- [Health report](https://what-works.ultrastable.org/health): the result of its last tick
- [Statements](https://what-works.ultrastable.org/claims.json): what it states, and the endpoint behind each statement
- [llms.txt](https://what-works.ultrastable.org/llms.txt): the index the running system serves, with every route it answers

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, where it runs and how it runs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for any coding agent
- [IDEA.md](IDEA.md): the one file a person writes
- [ultrastable.json](ultrastable.json): the manifest this file, the README blocks, CITATION.cff, publiccode.yml and codemeta.json are rendered from
- [codemeta.json](codemeta.json): software metadata (CodeMeta 3.0)
